claims: Mr. Nobody Against Putin won Best Documentary Feature at the 2026 Oscars.
Mr. Nobody Against Putin was directed by David Borenstein and Pavel Talankin.
Mr. Nobody Against Putin follows a Russian teacher secretly filming propaganda in his school during the Ukraine war.
Other nominees for Best Documentary Feature at the 2026 Oscars included The Alabama Solution, Come See Me in the Good Light, Cutting Through Rocks, and The Perfect Neighbor.
Mr. Nobody Against Putin chronicles Pavel Talankin’s experience in Russia as he is forced to teach government-mandated lessons, which he critiques.
The Alabama Solution is an HBO documentary.
The Alabama Solution looks at the deadly prison system in Alabama, focusing on systemic issues and inmate testimony.
The Perfect Neighbor is a Netflix documentary.
The Perfect Neighbor explores the aftermath of a fatal shooting and community policing issues.
Come See Me in the Good Light is an Apple documentary.
Cutting Through Rocks focused on stories of perseverance, according to ABC30 Fresno.
All the Empty Rooms won Best Documentary Short at the 2026 Oscars.
All the Empty Rooms focused on the emotional stories of children killed in school shootings.
An acceptance speech for Best Documentary Feature Film is available on ABC YouTube dated March 15, 2026 with duration 1m.
An acceptance speech for Best Documentary Short Film is available on ABC YouTube dated March 15, 2026 with duration 58s.
